epics.name: User Account Management
epics.summary: Manage user accounts including registration, login, and profile management.

epics.name: Product Catalog
epics.summary: Manage product listings, categories, and search functionality.

epics.name: Shopping Cart
epics.summary: Implement shopping cart functionality for adding, removing, and viewing items.

epics.name: Checkout Process
epics.summary: Facilitate the checkout process including payment and order confirmation.

sprints.goal: This sprint establishes account setup and access across Product Catalog, User Account Management, so users can create accounts and sign in confidently.

stories.title: Product Listing
stories.description: As a user, I want to view a list of available products so that I can choose what to buy.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I am on the product listing page
And products are available

Scenario: View products
When I access the product listing
Then I should see a list of products
And each product should display its name and price

Scenario: No products available
Given no products are available
When I access the product listing
Then I should see a message indicating no products found

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the product listing page
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User sees a list of products

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the product listing page
test_cases.test_steps: 1) Access the page with no products
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User sees no products found message

stories.title: Product Search
stories.description: As a user, I want to search for products so that I can quickly find what I need.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I am on the product listing page
And products are available

Scenario: Successful search
Given I enter a valid product name
When I perform the search
Then I should see the relevant products

Scenario: No results found
Given I enter a non-existent product name
When I perform the search
Then I should see a message indicating no results found

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the product listing page
test_cases.test_steps: 1) Enter valid product name 2) Click search

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the product listing page
test_cases.test_steps: 1) Enter invalid product name 2) Click search
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User sees no results found message

stories.title: User Registration
stories.description: As a new user, I want to register for an account so that I can access personalized features.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I am on the registration page
And I have not registered before

Scenario: Successful registration
Given I fill in valid user details
When I submit the registration form
Then I should see a confirmation message
And receive a welcome email

Scenario: Registration with existing email
Given I fill in an email already registered
When I submit the registration form
Then I should see an error message

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the registration page
User is on the registration page

stories.title: User Login
stories.description: As a registered user, I want to log in to my account so that I can access my profile.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I have an existing account
And I am on the login page

Scenario: Successful login
Given I enter valid credentials
When I click the login button
Then I should be redirected to my dashboard

Scenario: Failed login
Given I enter invalid credentials
When I click the login button
Then I should see an error message

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User is redirected to the dashboard

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page

sprints.goal: This sprint delivers account setup and access across Product Catalog, Shopping Cart, so users can create accounts and sign in confidently.

stories.title: Product Details
stories.description: As a user, I want to view detailed information about a product so that I can make informed purchase decisions.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I am on the product listing page
And I select a product

Scenario: View product details
When I click on a product
Then I should see detailed information about the product
And an option to add it to the cart

Scenario: Product not found
Given I enter an invalid product ID
When I access the product details
Then I should see a product not found message

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the product listing page
User enters invalid product ID
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User sees product not found message

stories.title: Add to Cart
stories.description: As a user, I want to add products to my shopping cart so that I can purchase them later.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I am on the product details page
And I have selected a product

Scenario: Successful addition to cart
When I click 'Add to Cart'
Then the product should be added to my cart
And I should see a confirmation message

Scenario: Add out-of-stock product
Given the product is out of stock
When I click 'Add to Cart'
Then I should see an out-of-stock message

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the product details page
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Product is added to the cart

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the product details page
test_cases.test_steps: 1) Click 'Add to Cart' on out-of-stock product

stories.title: Profile Management
stories.description: As a logged-in user, I want to manage my profile so that I can update my information.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I am logged into my account
And I am on the profile page

Scenario: Update profile information
Given I change my details
When I save the changes
Then I should see a success message
And my updated information should be displayed

Scenario: Cancel profile update
Given I change my details
When I click cancel
Then I should see my original information

test_cases.preconditions: User is on the profile page
User is on the profile page

stories.title: View Cart
stories.description: As a user, I want to view the contents of my shopping cart so that I can review my selected items.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I have items in my cart
And I am on the cart page

Scenario: View items in cart
When I access the cart page
Then I should see a list of items in my cart
And the total price should be displayed

Scenario: Empty cart
Given my cart is empty
When I access the cart page
Then I should see a message indicating my cart is empty

test_cases.preconditions: User has items in the cart
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User sees items and total price

test_cases.preconditions: User's cart is empty

sprints.goal: This sprint focuses on cart and checkout journey across Shopping Cart, Checkout Process, so users can add items and complete purchase steps.

stories.title: Remove from Cart
stories.description: As a user, I want to remove products from my shopping cart so that I can adjust my selections.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I have items in my cart
And I am on the cart page

Scenario: Successful removal from cart
When I click 'Remove' on an item
Then the item should be removed from my cart
And the total price should be updated

Scenario: Remove item not in cart
Given I try to remove an item not in my cart
When I click 'Remove'
Then I should see an error message

test_cases.preconditions: User has items in the cart
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Item is removed from the cart

test_cases.preconditions: User tries to remove an item not in the cart

stories.title: Checkout
stories.description: As a user, I want to proceed to checkout so that I can finalize my purchase.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I have items in my cart
And I am on the checkout page

Scenario: Successful checkout
When I enter valid payment information
And I confirm the order
Then I should see an order confirmation message
And my order should be processed

Scenario: Checkout with empty cart
Given my cart is empty
When I try to access the checkout page
Then I should see an error message

test_cases.preconditions: User has items in the cart
User's cart is empty

stories.title: Order History
stories.description: As a user, I want to view my order history so that I can track my past purchases.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I am logged into my account
And I have made purchases

Scenario: View order history
When I access the order history page
Then I should see a list of my past orders
And the details of each order

Scenario: No orders found
Given I have not made any purchases
When I access the order history page
Then I should see a message indicating no orders found

test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has made purchases
User has not made any purchases
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User sees no orders found message

sprints.goal: This sprint advances post-purchase order experience across Checkout Process, so users can monitor and manage their orders.

stories.title: Order Confirmation Email
stories.description: As a user, I want to receive an order confirmation email so that I have a record of my purchase.
acceptance_criteria:
Background:
Given I have successfully completed a purchase

Scenario: Receive confirmation email
When I complete the checkout process
Then I should receive an email confirmation
And the email should contain my order details

Scenario: No email on failure
Given my purchase fails
When I try to complete the checkout
Then I should not receive an email confirmation

test_cases.preconditions: User has completed a purchase
User's purchase fails
test_cases.expected_behaviour: User does not receive confirmation email
